dimensions.assessment: Directly affects career appointees at the Nuclear Regulatory Commission and agency leadership responsible for compensation.
dimensions.evidence: the Chairman may fix the compensation of a career appointee at an annual rate of basic pay

dimensions.assessment: Allows pay adjustments for specific career appointees up to 110 percent of the maximum Senior Executive Service rate within the Commission.
dimensions.evidence: not greater than 110 percent of the maximum annual rate of basic pay for Senior Executive Service positions

dimensions.assessment: Alters pay caps for specific career personnel within existing agency structures, but states no overall federal budget or spending figures.
Amends section 161B of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 and reporting requirements under the ADVANCE Act of 2024 to include the new compensation authority.
dimensions.evidence: Section 161B of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 (42 U.S.C. 2201b) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent compensation authority for career appointees at the agency.

missing_information: Exact number of career appointees eligible for the higher pay rate is not specified.
Total monetary impact on the NRC payroll is not estimated.
importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 to give the Nuclear Regulatory Commission Chairman authority to fix basic pay for certain career appointees up to 110 percent of the maximum SES rate.
